## 3vhy Client v0.7.0

### New
- **Knives** (replaces Blades, your settings carry over): 8 knives (Karambit, Butterfly, Bayonet, Huntsman, Dagger, Phantom, Katana, Scythe) in Steel, Purple, Crimson, Ice or Gold, held big and close in your hand. Each has its own draw and inspect (press Y), slashes alternate, right click stabs, and the knife sways as you look around.
- Pick which hotbar slots are knives right in the Knives settings, or let every sword be one. Position, turn and size sliders with a Reset button.
- **Skies**: 10 living skies (Galaxy, Aether, Nocturne, Amethyst, Opaline, Rain, Snow, Fire, Hollow, Afterglow) with live previews in the settings, plus speed, brightness, tint, stars, time of day and light weather particles.
- **Name Protect Auto**: finds your stats, the server's address and rank tags on the scoreboard and tab list and hides them everywhere, no rules needed. See what it found and leave anything visible with one click.
- **Performance** panel: Quality, Balanced or Performance in one click.

### Changed
- Every button, text box, slider, checkbox, tab, list, tooltip and the chat bar is now 3vhy glass, including buttons from other mods like Mod Menu.
- The HUD runs faster and smoother, with fewer stutters.
- Name Protect now shows you as "Player" by default.

### Fixed
- Sky Lyrics no longer show through blocks; they're part of the sky now.
- Lyrics are found for far more songs, and a busy lyrics server no longer means "no lyrics".
- Mod Menu's Mods button was a grey Minecraft button.
